name: Kousaka Manami
source:
An introvert and timid girl. She's weak to pressure, and the type who can't say no to requests. She encounters lots of molesters it's as if she's releasing pheromones which attracts them. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=706833]Getchu[/url]]
